end.parentNote: They practised seeing 3 equal groups of 4 and counting 4, 8, 12. Counting equal groups went well when each group had four items. They mixed up the picture labels and did not understand the packet example; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, draw three plates with four objects on each and ask them to count by fours.
